• Contact centres 30-60 days before contract renewal to discuss program value and address any internal delivery plans before they solidify.

• Audit coach allocation and session timing across all active centres to prevent recurring scheduling friction that drives cancellations.

• Create a competitive internal delivery comparison document highlighting cost, staffing, and quality risks of in-house programs to share during renewal conversations.
